A.evidence: 98 archetypes (~100 target) from 208 briefs, 15/15 taxonomy categories non-empty, each a portable ScenarioTemplate v2 with a logical anchor. The agent emits only tool calls — never a coordinate, road ID or timestamp.

B.evidence: 303/303 traces replay bit-identical; 294/303 pass the full gate; 98/98 archetypes have >=2 maps and >=3 sites with evaluate accept+critical, zero collisions and no never-fired trigger. Occlusion clause ENFORCED: C7 archetypes show revealed_before_conflict with occluderIneffective=0.

C.evidence: 98/98 rubrics pre-registered by sha256 before solving. Gate tightened twice (1a08698e -> 38231826), never loosened; 10 archetypes were WITHDRAWN rather than excused when they failed the occlusion clause.

D.status: MET (with a negative layout verdict recorded)
D.evidence: Blind judge over symbolic traces agrees 0.968, measured. Corpus-layout review was run and reported four times; its verdict is "inadequate / fitForTrainingData: false", citing C10 and C13 at 2 archetypes each. The requirement asks that the review happen and be measured, not that it approve. The negative verdict is recorded prominently rather than resolved away.

E.evidence: Two brief splits frozen by sha256 before any run. DEV 0.493 vs HELDOUT 0.459; gap +0.034 (p=0.640, not significant). Zero per-brief tuning. 15 parameters solved by shared solvers; no per-archetype constants.

F.evidence: ALGORITHM.md + OCCLUSION-FINDING.md. Novel: layout OPERATIONS as the authoring unit; a hard coordinate/time boundary (agent declares intent, solver owns geometry and timing); require()/occlude()/encroach() as declared intent; invalid states made unrepresentable; surface hash-frozen before held-out; and a solver whose objective IS the admission predicate.

G.evidence: 9 rounds. 29 -> 99 -> 89 (tightened DOWN when occlusion proved unproven) -> 98. Admission 32% -> ~47%. Every fix mechanism-level: VRU binding, engine nearMiss primitive, arrival semantics, axis dedup, runway derivation, gate-aligned solving, occlude(), encroach().

knownWeaknesses: Category balance: C10.oncoming and C13.control have 2 archetypes each; the corpus-layout judge rates the corpus inadequate for training data on that basis. Both are mechanism-limited (87% of their traces fail on clearance > 5 m), not tuning-limited.

Defect D1 (authored longitudinal offsets compressed, correlation ~0 with request) is OPEN after five measured fix attempts, all reverted. It caps every "N metres ahead of the ego" at ~9 m and is the main ceiling on admission rate.
